core: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling in striated muscle
qualifier: ryanodine receptor release and SERCA reuptake control of contraction/relaxation
name: Striated muscle sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release and reuptake regulation
rationale: All members concern cytosolic calcium handling in cardiac/skeletal muscle (RyR release, SERCA import, NCX extrusion, relaxation and rate); unlike the confusables, the theme centres on regulation of ryanodine-sensitive release and cardiac contraction rather than ER calcium concentration or contractile force.

qualifier: BMAL1-CLOCK/CRY-PER core loop with nuclear receptor and PGC-1alpha metabolic outputs
name: BMAL1-CLOCK/CRY-PER circadian feedback loop and metabolic coupling
rationale: Members are the core clock loop (BMAL1:CLOCK activation, CRY:PER repression, entrainment, REV-ERB/ROR) plus metabolic clock outputs (PGC-1alpha, PPARA, heme, fatty acid); the core clock loop is what the gluconeogenesis/beta-cell/thermogenesis confusables lack.

core: Lymphocyte polarization and immunological synapse formation
qualifier: Vav1/Cdc42 Rho GTPase signaling
name: Lymphocyte polarity and immunological synapse via Vav1/Cdc42 signaling
rationale: Members cover T cell polarity, synapse and raft localization, lymphocyte homing/aggregation and Rho-family (Vav1, Cdc42, Rhotekin) signaling; the confusables instead emphasise integrin adhesion, CORO1A-DEF6 or NADPH oxidase/RHOH.

qualifier: RUNX3 growth-arrest targets and cadherin gene transcription
name: RUNX3 tumour-suppressor targets and cadherin gene transcription
rationale: Members are transcriptional programs for growth arrest/apoptosis (RUNX3 targets CDKN1A, BIM, p14-ARF; FOXO cell cycle) and CDH1/CDH11/TGFBR3 expression; confusables instead cover ALK/STAT3, PTEN/PD-L1 or RUNX3 WNT/YAP regulation.

qualifier: primordial germ cell migration, survival and meiotic entry
name: Primordial germ cell migration, survival and meiotic entry
rationale: All members concern early germ cell development (PGC migration, proliferation, elimination of ectopic germ cells, meiosis activation, maturation), distinct from the oocyte-maturation and gonadal somatic/gonadotropin confusables.

qualifier: DAP12 signaling and macrophage fusion, without amyloid or apoptotic-cell clearance
name: Microglial activation, proliferation and DAP12 signaling
rationale: Members describe microglial activation, migration, proliferation, cytotoxicity and survival with DAP12 signaling and macrophage fusion; confusables are defined by amyloid-beta handling and apoptotic cell clearance.

qualifier: via PLCgamma1, RAS and FRS2/3 adaptors
name: BDNF-TRKB signaling through PLCgamma1, RAS and FRS2/3
rationale: All members are BDNF-activated NTRK2 signaling through PLCG1, RAS and FRS2/FRS3; confusables add CDK5, PI3K, RAC1 branches, NTF3 ligand or NTRK3.

core: Regional neural patterning and neuronal fate specification
qualifier: dorsoventral neural tube patterning, spinal motor/interneuron identity, forebrain neuron migration
name: Dorsoventral neural patterning, neuronal subtype specification and migration
rationale: Members span dorsoventral patterning of spinal cord and forebrain, specification of motor and interneuron subtypes, and cortical/olfactory neuron migration; confusables lack the spinal patterning and fate specification and instead feature neuroblast division, glia and commissures.

qualifier: dopamine receptor signaling, catecholamine reuptake and drug-reward behavior
name: Dopamine receptor signaling, catecholamine reuptake and addictive drug responses
rationale: Members cover dopamine receptor signaling, DAT/NET-mediated catecholamine uptake and transport, and behavioral responses to cocaine, amphetamine, nicotine and ethanol; confusables instead centre on catecholamine/serotonin biosynthesis and degradation or nicotinic/alcohol genetics.

qualifier: ZIP/ZnT (SLC39/SLC30) zinc homeostasis and cadmium detoxification
name: ZIP/ZnT zinc transport and cadmium uptake and detoxification
rationale: All members concern zinc import/efflux and homeostasis by ZIP/ZnT carriers and transport/response to cadmium; confusables instead cover manganese, copper, iron or metallothionein/MTF1 responses.

qualifier: homocysteine-to-cysteine conversion with serine and cysteine catabolism
name: Transsulfuration and cysteine/serine catabolism
rationale: Members are the transsulfuration route forming cysteine from homocysteine and serine plus sulfur amino acid/cysteine catabolism; confusables cover selenium/sulfide metabolism or glycine, threonine and other amino acid catabolism.

qualifier: KATP channels, incretins and fatty acid receptors
name: KATP-, incretin- and fatty acid-regulated beta-cell insulin secretion
rationale: Members regulate glucose-stimulated insulin secretion through KATP channels (ABCC8/9), GLP-1/GIP, FFAR1 fatty acid signaling and acetylcholine; confusables center on glucagon, somatostatin, adrenergic inhibition or insulin processing.

qualifier: ectodermal appendages (hair follicle, nail, sebaceous and mammary gland)
name: Keratinocyte differentiation, cornification and ectodermal appendage development
rationale: Members cover keratinocyte proliferation/differentiation, cornified envelope and skin barrier, and ectodermal appendage formation; confusables are distinguished by melanocyte and pigmentation biology.

qualifier: astrocytic glutamate-glutamine handling
name: Glutamate reuptake and astrocytic glutamate-glutamine handling
rationale: All three members concern plasma-membrane glutamate uptake, including astrocytic uptake and glutamine cycling; confusables are monoamine, GABA or aspartate transport.

core: Viral life cycle in host cells
qualifier: RNA virus entry, translation, replication and assembly, without reverse transcription or integration
name: RNA virus entry, translation, genome replication and assembly
rationale: Members span attachment/entry, viral translation, genome replication, protein maturation and virion assembly for coronaviruses, dengue, RSV, influenza and HIV structural proteins plus host restriction; confusables are defined by reverse transcription, integration, HCMV and latency.

qualifier: axonemal dynein arm assembly and motility
name: Motile cilium and sperm flagellum assembly and motility
rationale: Most members concern motile axoneme assembly (dynein arms, central apparatus), cilia beating, mucociliary clearance and sperm motility/mitochondrial sheath; confusables are primary-cilium IFT/photoreceptor or tubulin modification themes.

qualifier: NOTCH1 intracellular domain, including PEST-mutant constitutive signaling
name: NOTCH1 intracellular domain transcription, including PEST mutants
rationale: Members are NOTCH1 NICD-driven HLH target transcription and its constitutive PEST/HD+PEST mutant forms; confusables cover NOTCH2/3/4 transcription or upstream NOTCH1 activation and HD/translocation mutants.

qualifier: adenylate cyclase activation to CREB and DARPP-32
name: Adenylate cyclase-cAMP-PKA signaling to CREB and DARPP-32
rationale: Members cover cAMP synthesis and breakdown, PKA activation, CREB phosphorylation and DARPP-32 downstream of stimulatory GPCRs; confusables instead feature CaMK-CREB, Gi/adrenergic inhibition or Gq/calcium signaling.

qualifier: connexin trafficking and assembly with electrical coupling
name: Connexin gap junction assembly, trafficking and electrical coupling
rationale: Members concern connexin oligomerization, trafficking, gap junction assembly/turnover and electrical/neuron-glia transmission; confusables are nodal adhesion or channel-regulation themes lacking connexin biology.

qualifier: endocytic recycling and active zone maintenance
name: Presynaptic vesicle endocytosis, recycling and active zone maintenance
rationale: Members regulate synaptic vesicle endocytosis, uncoating, recycling and clustering and presynaptic active zone/cytoskeleton structure; confusables instead feature postsynaptic organization, clathrin coat assembly or vesicle docking and exocytosis.

qualifier: including HIV Tat-dependent transcription
name: RNA polymerase II promoter escape and pausing, including HIV Tat
rationale: Members describe Pol II preinitiation, promoter escape, CTD phosphorylation/capping, pausing and elongation complex formation, much of it on the HIV promoter with Tat; confusables are Pol I/III and rRNA transcription or termination themes.

qualifier: EGFR/ERBB2 mutants and FGFR fusions and amplifications
name: Oncogenic EGFR/ERBB2 mutant and FGFR fusion/amplification signaling
rationale: All members are constitutive signaling by cancer-associated RTK variants, chiefly EGFR/ERBB2 mutants and FGFR1-3 fusions/amplification (plus LTK); confusables are PDGFR, FLT3 and ALK variant themes.

qualifier: NOTCH2/3/4 intracellular domains, in Th2 and pancreatic development
name: NOTCH2/3/4 intracellular domain target-gene transcription
rationale: Members are Notch nuclear transcriptional output via NOTCH2, NOTCH3 and NOTCH4 NICDs with HLH targets and developmental contexts (Th2, pancreatic bud, RUNX3); confusables are NOTCH1-specific activation and mutant signaling.

qualifier: with diphthamide, hypusine and hydroxylation modification of translation factors
name: Translation termination, mRNA surveillance and translation factor modification
rationale: Members cover termination, NMD, non-stop and no-go decay plus post-translational modifications of the translation machinery (eEF2 diphthamide, eIF5A hypusine, hydroxylation); confusables are protein methylation, tRNA modification or translation initiation.

qualifier: serotonin and tachykinin receptor signaling
name: Serotonin and tachykinin receptor control of gastrointestinal motility
rationale: Members are serotonin and tachykinin receptor signaling and GI smooth muscle contraction, gastric motility and acid secretion; confusables are general/urogenital smooth muscle, histamine/itch or muscarinic signaling.
